Field.name: ValueFile
Field.manpage: Input file containing values to be stored in the model.

Field.name: InputFile
Field.manpage: Input model file to clone. If this option is not entered, the first non-option argument will be used for the input file.

Field.name: OutputFile
Field.manpage: Name to give the output model. If this option is not entered, the second non-option argument will be used.

Field.name: ColumnNumber
Field.usage: Column number containing the values to be set.
Field.manpage: Specify a particular column in a multi-column values file which contains the values to associate with each point in the model. The result is equivalent to having constructed a single-column values file containing only these entries.

Field.name: MinMaxFile
Field.usage: Per object min and max values for pseudo-coloring
Field.manpage: Input file giving the minimum and maximum values for pseudo-coloring specific objects.

Field.name: SkipLines
Field.usage: Number of header lines to skip
Field.manpage: Number of lines to ignore at beginning of the values file. Useful for skipping over header / comment lines.
